title: Short video script
description: The single JSON object that flows through the pipeline from script generation to publishing. Every stage reads it and writes back into it; nothing else carries state.

id.description: Stable job id, e.g. 2026-10-08-a-prayer-for-a-new-job. Used as the folder name under output/.

pillar.description: Content pillar. Drives the rotation, the tone rules, and the safety level.

series.description: Repeatable format name from docs/CONTENT_STRATEGY.md, e.g. a-prayer-for, to-the-person-who, one-verse-one-minute.

idea.description: The raw prompt that started this job, exactly as typed or as generated by the self-feeding scheduler.

hook.description: The first spoken line. Must stand alone and earn the next two seconds.

text.description: Spoken words for this scene. One to three sentences.

type.description: Which rung of the visual ladder renders this scene. The pipeline may downgrade (ai-video -> ai-image -> stock-clip -> brand-card) when a provider fails or the budget is spent.

prompt.description: Search terms for stock, or the image/video generation prompt. Never contains text to be rendered inside the image.

mood.description: Short mood tag used to pick colour and music, e.g. calm-dawn, warm-kitchen, rain-window.

caption_emphasis.description: Words to highlight in the on-screen captions.

close.description: The last spoken line. A blessing, a question, or a gentle invitation to come back tomorrow. Never a hard sell.

description.description: Platform description. The publish stage appends crisis resources when safety.crisis_resources is true.

track_id.description: Filled in by the render stage from the licensed music library.

sensitivity.description: high = suicide, self-harm, abuse, grief; triggers stricter language rules and crisis resources.

quotes.description: Every quoted line and where it comes from. Scripture must name translation and reference. Anything that cannot be sourced is rewritten as an original line.

publish.description: Written by the publish stage, one entry per platform.
